# Marketrends – LLM Context

> Marketrends is a Norwegian AI-powered news aggregation platform covering finance,
> technology, crypto, and market trends. Articles are ingested from 20+ RSS feeds,
> rewritten by an AI pipeline, and published automatically in Norwegian.

## Quick reference

- Live site: https://marketrends.no
- Repository: https://github.com/openorway/marketrends
- News: https://marketrends.no/sitemap-news.xml (news sitemap)
- Sitemap index: https://marketrends.no/sitemap-index.xml

## Tech stack

- React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 5
- shadcn/ui + Radix UI + Tailwind CSS
- Supabase (PostgreSQL + Deno Edge Functions)
- React Router v6 + TanStack Query v5
- Hosted on Lovable.dev (auto-deploys from GitHub)

## Content categories

- Krypto & Trading
- Teknologi & AI
- Finans & Marked
- Gründer & Startups
- Penger & Karriere
- Trender & Analyse
- Guider & Forklart

## Authority hubs (cluster pages)

- https://marketrends.no/cluster/ai — Kunstig intelligens
- https://marketrends.no/cluster/krypto — Kryptovaluta
- https://marketrends.no/cluster/fintech — Fintech
- https://marketrends.no/cluster/startup — Startup
- https://marketrends.no/cluster/investering — Investering
- https://marketrends.no/cluster/daytrading — Daytrading

## Knowledge resources

- https://marketrends.no/ressurser — Datasett, rapporter og offentlige kilder
